summary: Sadot Group Inc. filed an 8-K to report its acquisition of all shares of Anira Consulting FZC (Tradewell) for $12M, paid via 135,000 common shares ($405K), 1,000 Series B Convertible Preferred shares ($6.595M stated value), and a $5M convertible note. The acquisition provides TradeOS, a CTRM platform for commodity trading. The board approved the deal; no advisor named. Mechanical details include a 19.99% change-of-control threshold, a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker (expandable to 9.99% on 61 days' notice), and NASdaq compliance. Watch for shareholder dilution from conversions and integration risk.
